representations.tonto:sans-nom: Sans-Nom has begun watching the eastern hall instead of asking about it.

beats.text: Sans-Nom stops where the corridor narrows and the eastern hall begins to feel less like architecture than a held breath.

actor_needs.reason: Tonto is physically present and can react to the child's hesitation.

choices.label: Ask Tonto what lies beyond the door

memory_intents.summary: Sans-Nom hesitated at the eastern hall and did not yet cross into it.

beats.text: Tonto answers by beginning somewhere before Sans-Nom was born.
Sans-Nom turns away, and the unopened door becomes heavier because it has not been touched.

revision_notes: Bounded Phase 0 packet: three nodes, no all-cast fanout.
